product.description: Add a professional storage solution to your office workstation, computer desk, or open office setup, even if you don't have built-in cabinets and drawers. This powder-coated steel cabinet features rounded corners, which add strength and durability, while avoiding the sharp corners and edges found in other designs. Sturdy, dual-wheel casters make it easy to move and reposition the cabinet, even when it is full. The bottom drawer fits file folders and documents, while the two spacious upper drawers are perfect for items that need to be within easy reach. An organizer tray is included to help with small objects. The lockable drawers sit on high quality drawer glides to provide smooth and quiet operation.
